about: Touched-path → test-suite map, read by `botq test-map`. First matching rule wins; `tests: []` means consciously untested and must carry its why.

rules.why: the bootstrap page keeps the token in memory only, erases a copy saved by an earlier version, and its service worker caches nothing; a stubbed transport stands in for the wasm client
the wasm client artifacts, manifest and icons have no headless harness; verified by opening the page
the wasm iroh client has no unit tests; wasm/build.sh builds it and the served page proves it
